summary: Reviewed both FixedDurationStrategy classes (API and AI namespaces) and all 4 consumer files.
All PHP source files correctly use the new DURATION_X_UNIT underscore convention. Zero stale constant references in executable PHP code confirmed by grep.
AI FixedDurationStrategy correctly adds DURATION_1_MIN (60), DURATION_5_MIN (300), DURATION_15_MIN (900) and now has a complete constant set matching the API class.
Test fixtures (TestCacheableMethod, TestUserScopedMethod) and test files (APICacheStrategyTest, APICacheIntegrationTest) all use new constant names.

Two non-blocking source documentation gaps found: (1) README.md contains old constant names in code examples (lines 66 and 114) and in a reference table (lines 198-199). (2) module-context.yaml FixedDurationStrategy keyword entry still lists old names — this is a hand-maintained file; composer build alone will not fix it. Both need manual update.
Minor style inconsistency: AI class constructor parameter lacks spacing around = (no-space style) vs the API class which uses space style. Non-blocking.

comments.note: Both FixedDurationStrategy classes (API and AI namespaces) are cleanly and consistently renamed. Constants follow the DURATION_X_UNIT convention, values are correct (1_MIN=60, 5_MIN=300, 15_MIN=900, 1_HOUR=3600, 6_HOURS=21600, 12_HOURS=43200, 24_HOURS=86400). The AI class correctly mirrors the API class's full constant set. No blocking issues.

src/classes/Application/API/Cache/README.md contains two code examples with stale constant names: line 66 uses DURATION_1HOUR (should be DURATION_1_HOUR) and line 114 uses DURATION_15MIN (should be DURATION_15_MIN). Additionally, the constant list table at line 198-199 lists all old names unchanged. If a developer copies either example verbatim, the result is a static analysis failure or IDE warning. This is a non-blocking correctness gap in hand-maintained documentation — the Documentation agent should fix it.

src/classes/Application/API/Cache/module-context.yaml still lists old constant names in the FixedDurationStrategy keyword entry (DURATION_1MIN, DURATION_5MIN, etc.). This feeds directly into CTX-generated documentation. Since module-context.yaml is a hand-maintained source file (not regenerated), it must be updated manually before running composer build — simply running the build will not fix the generated output. The Documentation or Developer agent should update this entry as a follow-up.

The AI FixedDurationStrategy constructor spacing (int $durationInSeconds=self::DURATION_1_HOUR, no space before =) differs slightly from the API class (int $durationInSeconds = self::DURATION_1_HOUR, space before =). Minor style inconsistency, non-blocking, but consistency across sibling classes would be preferable.
